tools.name: racket_quiz
tools.description: Shows the Padel USA Racket Finder as a tappable quiz card (level, style, feel, arm comfort, budget...). The shopper answers with a few taps and the card shows the 3 best-fitting rackets with Shop now buttons. Use it only when the shopper asks to take the quiz or wants to answer the questions themsel

tools.name: find_racket
tools.description: Recommends the 3 best-fitting padel rackets for a player from the Padel USA store (in-stock rackets only; Padel USA ships within the United States). Uses the same matching engine as the Racket Finder on padelusa.com, ranked purely on fit to the player. Answer the Finder's questions yourself from wha

tools.name: racket_details
tools.description: Looks up up to 3 rackets by name in the Padel USA store and returns their specs (shape, balance, weight, core feel, handling, level, play style, surface), price, and product and add-to-cart links. Use it to answer questions about a specific racket or to compare 2 or 3 rackets side by side. A racket

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Finds in-stock padel gear at Padel USA other than a racket fit: shoes, balls, bags, overgrips, accessories, bundles (and rackets by name or brand). Returns up to 6 items with price, available sizes/options with their variant_id, and links. For racket recommendations use find_racket instead.

tools.name: build_kit
tools.description: Completes a racket with what the player needs: balls, an overgrip, a bag, and shoes when a US shoe size is given. One in-stock pick per slot with a short reason and its variant_id, ready for add_to_cart.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Adds items to the shopper's Padel USA cart (creates the cart on first use). Pass the cart_id from the previous cart result to keep adding to the same cart. Give the shopper's 5-digit US ZIP to show shipping options. If the result has "essentials", mention them once in one sentence with their reason

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Changes quantities in the cart (0 removes the line) and/or the delivery ZIP. If the result has "essentials", mention them once in one sentence with their reason (things the player genuinely needs with this cart, never an upsell push) and add them only if the shopper says yes; never repeat the sugges

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Shows the cart: items, subtotal, shipping options for the ZIP, and the checkout link. If the result has "essentials", mention them once in one sentence with their reason (things the player genuinely needs with this cart, never an upsell push) and add them only if the shopper says yes; never repeat t

tools.name: padel_guide
tools.description: Finds Padel USA's own guides for a padel question (rules, technique, choosing gear, care, sizing). Returns up to 3 articles with a summary and link. Use it to answer as a padel expert and cite the guide.

tools.name: order_help
tools.description: After a purchase: where to track an order, start a return or exchange, file a warranty claim, report a lost or damaged parcel, or contact the team. Returns the right Padel USA page. Never ask for order numbers or email addresses in chat; the page verifies the shopper.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "find_racket" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Recommends the 3 best-fitting padel rackets for a player from the Padel USA store (in-stock rackets only; Padel USA ships within the United States). Uses the sa…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: view_cart · Private data: order_help · Public sink: order_help.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: view_cart · Private data: order_help · Public sink: order_help

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
